required_semantics: pTimePortion selects week, month, or quarter and drives DATETRUNC and DATEADD.
pMoveAvg controls a trailing window that includes the current mark and the previous pMoveAvg-1 marks.
pTimeFrame limits visible marks relative to the latest display date through a table-calculation filter.
Sales and Moving Avg share a synchronized dual axis.
required_interactions: All three parameter controls are available on the dashboard.
required_views: One trend worksheet and one dashboard.
observable_assertions: The workbook contains all three parameters with the article-defined domains and defaults.
The workbook contains the four-field calculation dependency chain.
The worksheet uses Date to Display as a True filter.
The worksheet contains two line panes on a synchronized dual axis.
The dashboard includes the worksheet and all three parameter controls.
allowed_differences: Fonts, exact colors, padding, and tooltip prose may differ.
The worksheet and dashboard names may be clearer than the source names.
